title: DOME and OSAI featured in BioHackathon Europe 2025
description: DOME team members contributed to two key projects at the BioHackathon Europe in Berlin: Project 6, 'Defining the components of an ELIXIR ML ecosystem', and Project 31, 'World DOMEination: Conquering ML metadata, one standard at a time'.

title: ELIXIR launches AI Ecosystem Focus Group
description: ELIXIR has officially launched the AI Ecosystem Focus Group to address the growing importance of Artificial Intelligence in the life sciences and to build on the work of the original Machine Learning Focus Group.

title: OSAI sister website launched
description: The Open and Sustainable AI (OSAI) website is now live, expanding on the DOME recommendations to provide resources for sustainable AI development in research.

title: DOME Registry presented at ISMB/ECCB 2025
description: The DOME Registry was presented at the ISMB/ECCB 2025 conference in San Juan, Puerto Rico. The work, 'DOME Registry Supporting ML transparency and reproducibility in the life sciences', was featured as both a talk and a conference poster.

title: ML Ecosystem session at ELIXIR All Hands 2025
description: DOME was featured as part of a workshop on the 'ELIXIR ML Ecosystem' during the ELIXIR All Hands meeting in Thessaloniki, Greece.

title: New paper on Open and Sustainable AI in Life Sciences
description: A new publication led by Gavin Farrell outlines a framework for creating Open and Sustainable AI (OSAI), building on principles established by the DOME recommendations.

title: Presentation on DOME and Sustainable AI at CERN
description: Gavin Farrell presented on 'DOME: Life Science ML Best Practices & the AI Ecosystem' at the FAIR and environmentally sustainable ML workshop hosted by CERN.

title: ELIXIR encourages publishers to adopt DOME
description: Following successful adoption by GigaScience, ELIXIR is encouraging all publishers of life science research to adopt the DOME machine learning recommendations.

title: DOME Registry Tutorial v2 Published
description: An updated video tutorial for the DOME Registry service has been released, guiding users on creating entries for machine learning methods in papers.

title: DOME presented at RDA AI in Action Workshop
description: DOME will be presented at the Research Data Alliance (RDA) event "AI in Action: How Researchers Leverage AI" in a session focusing on Europe and Americas friendly time zones.

title: DOME Registry paper published in GigaScience
description: Our latest paper detailing the DOME Registry implementation has been published in GigaScience journal.

title: DOME - ML Best Practices Webinar with Australian BioCommons
description: Join us for a webinar on Machine Learning Best Practices & Recommendations in collaboration with Australian BioCommons.

title: GigaScience talk on DOME adoption at ICG
description: GigaScience presented a talk on DOME adoption at the 19th International Conference on Genomics (ICG).

title: DOME - ML Best Practices Webinar with ELIXIR
description: A webinar on Machine Learning Best Practices & Recommendations in collaboration with ELIXIR Europe.

title: DOME Registry adopted by GigaScience
description: We're pleased to announce that GigaScience has adopted the DOME Registry for use in their publication process.

title: ELIXIR-UK Community Call on DOME
description: Tim Beck introduced the DOME guidelines and their application for health data ML analyses at the ELIXIR-UK Human Data Community Call.

title: DOME Registry service launched
description: The DOME Registry service is now live, providing a technical solution to help implement the DOME Recommendations.

title: DOME interpretation for Proteomics published
description: A perspective was published in the Journal of Proteome Research interpreting the DOME recommendations for the specific context of proteomics and metabolomics.

title: DOME Recommendations paper published in Nature Methods
description: Our foundational paper on the DOME Recommendations has been published in Nature Methods.

title: ELIXIR All Hands Meeting 2021 Workshop
description: Workshop on defining the road ahead for machine learning in ELIXIR at the ELIXIR All Hands Meeting 2021.

title: DOME-ML GitHub repository created
description: We have created a GitHub repository for the DOME project to foster open collaboration.

title: First manuscript deposited to arXiv
description: Our first manuscript detailing the DOME framework has been deposited to the arXiv preprint server.

title: ELIXIR Machine Learning Focus Group formed
description: The ELIXIR Machine Learning Focus Group has been established with domain experts from across Europe.
